supabase_sql:
create schema if not exists ops;
create schema if not exists cc;
create schema if not exists audit;

create table if not exists ops.session_bootstrap (
  id text primary key,
  epoch text not null,
  mode text not null,
  role text not null,
  primary_identity text not null,
  payload jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists ops.operator_memory (
  key text primary key,
  value jsonb not null,
  source text not null default 'pen',
  evidence text not null default 'PARTIAL',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists cc.feature_flags (
  key text primary key,
  value boolean not null default false,
  scope text not null default 'global',
  description text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists commercial.generated_offers (
  offer_slug text primary key,
  business_slug text not null,
  group_code text,
  offer_title text not null,
  target_market text not null,
  problem text not null,
  signal text not null,
  intervention text not null,
  outcome text not null,
  commercial_model text not null,
  cta text not null,
  source_version text default 'seller_mode_v1',
  evidence text not null default 'PARTIAL',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

insert into ops.session_bootstrap (id, epoch, mode, role, primary_identity, payload, is_active, updated_at)
values (
  'bootstrap_seller_mode_v1',
  'SELLER_MODE',
  'PROD_OPERATOR',
  'MASTER_ORCHESTRATOR',
  'SELLER',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'directive', 'monetise existing assets; no new builds without revenue link',
    'done', jsonb_build_array('offer_exists','target_market_defined','cta_live_or_queued','revenue_path_clear','receipt_exists'),
    'handover', 'old sessions must summarise, deposit to PEN, capture receipt, close'
  ),
  true,
  now()
)
on conflict (id) do update set
  epoch = excluded.epoch,
  mode = excluded.mode,
  role = excluded.role,
  primary_identity = excluded.primary_identity,
  payload = excluded.payload,
  is_active = true,
  updated_at = now();

insert into ops.operator_memory (key, value, source, evidence, updated_at)
values (
  'global.session_identity',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'role','MASTER_ORCHESTRATOR',
    'mode','PROD_OPERATOR',
    'stance','SELLER',
    'blocked','builder drift',
    'rule','package, price, position, sell'
  ),
  'pen',
  'PARTIAL',
  now()
)
on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value, source = excluded.source, evidence = excluded.evidence, updated_at = now();

insert into cc.feature_flags (key, value, scope, description, updated_at)
values (
  'SELLER_MODE_ON',
  true,
  'global',
  'Prioritise commercialisation, offer generation and sales execution over builder-mode work.',
  now()
)
on conflict (key) do update set value = true, scope = excluded.scope, description = excluded.description, updated_at = now();

insert into audit.log (event_type, source, payload, created_at)
values (
  'SELLER_MODE_ACCELERATION_BUNDLE_APPLIED',
  'pen',
  jsonb_build_object('idempotency_key','seller_mode_acceleration_bundle_v1','toggle','SELLER_MODE_ON','registry','public.mcp_business_registry'),
  now()
);

command_centre_toggle_binding.label: Seller Mode
command_centre_toggle_binding.visible_effect: Sessions package, price, position and sell. Builder-mode work must be handed over through PEN.
command_centre_toggle_binding.required_query: select key, value, scope, description, updated_at from cc.feature_flags where key = 'SELLER_MODE_ON';

offer_generator_spec.idempotency: offer_slug primary key generated from business_slug || '-seller-mode-offer-v1'
offer_generator_spec.generation_rule: For each active business, create one practical revenue offer using existing asset/category metadata. Do not invent operational capability that is not evidenced by registry fields. Use PARTIAL evidence when registry lacks proof.
offer_generator_spec.sql_template: insert into commercial.generated_offers (offer_slug,business_slug,group_code,offer_title,target_market,problem,signal,intervention,outcome,commercial_model,cta,evidence) select business_slug || '-seller-mode-offer-v1', business_slug, group_code, coalesce(nullif(business_name,''), business_slug) || ' Revenue Activation Offer', 'Existing buyers, partners and enterprise prospects', 'Existing asset has insufficient commercial packaging or CTA.', 'Registry confirms active business asset requiring monetisation path.', 'Package current asset into a clear offer with pricing, CTA and outbound motion.', 'Qualified lead or paid activation path created.', 'Assessment, report, subscription, API, workshop or enterprise package depending on fit.', 'Book a revenue activation call / start assessment / request proposal.', 'PARTIAL' from public.mcp_business_registry where status = 'active' on conflict (offer_slug) do update set offer_title = excluded.offer_title, target_market = excluded.target_market, problem = excluded.problem, signal = excluded.signal, intervention = excluded.intervention, outcome = excluded.outcome, commercial_model = excluded.commercial_model, cta = excluded.cta, updated_at = now();

validation_queries: select count(*) as generated_offer_count from commercial.generated_offers where source_version = 'seller_mode_v1' or offer_slug like '%seller-mode-offer-v1';
select * from audit.log where event_type = 'SELLER_MODE_ACCELERATION_BUNDLE_APPLIED' order by created_at desc limit 1;

failure_handling.if_audit_log_shape_differs: write receipt file with SQL error and impact; do not pretend success
failure_handling.if_commercial_schema_missing: create schema commercial before generated_offers table
failure_handling.if_registry_columns_differ: fallback to business_slug/status/group_code only; receipt mismatch details
failure_handling.rollback: set cc.feature_flags SELLER_MODE_ON=false only if explicitly instructed; archive not delete
